name: Blood-Cursed Armor gives the whole raid its armor bonus (#3705)
contract: Blood-Cursed Armor 685028 has a single effect in Spell.dbc: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura) with aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, MiscValue 1 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL, i.e. armor), BasePoints 389, DieSides 1, RealPointsPerLevel 25.0, SpellLevel/BaseLevel 30, radius index 12 (100 yards) and TargetA 1. The native handler is AuraEffect::HandleAuraModResistance. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue adds (level - max(BaseLevel, SpellLevel)) * RealPointsPerLevel before the DieSides roll, so at level 60 the amount is 389 + 30*25 + 1 = 1140; the snapshot tooltip's 390 is that same record read at level 30. The assertion band is deliberately wider than 1140 because UNIT_MOD_ARMOR's total percentage is applied after the flat amount. The point of the check is the raid half: a solo reading would not tell an area aura from a self-only one.

steps.label: The caster gains the level-60 armor amount
The grouped ally gains it too
